about: The challenge's styles and bases, as proposed in styles-proposal.md (DRAFT, drafted by the coding agent, Claude, a closed model by Anthropic, 2026-11-03). Read by `npm run seed:designs -- --bases-plan`, which prices it and calls nothing. Existing styles are named as published (body.title); new styles carry their full text. Each style's `model` is the model its samples are made with; each plan's `bases` lists the three base styles in their fixed order (CHALLENGE.baseStyles) with the model that makes the bases' views.

styles.name: Miniature
styles.text: A photograph of a hand-painted miniature model: smooth sculpted resin and painted wood with a satin finish, softly rounded simplified forms, any people as small painted figurines, soft studio light, soft shadows on the ground, shallow depth of field, clear readable faces and hands.

styles.name: Gouache
styles.text: Painted illustration in opaque gouache on textured paper: visible flat brush strokes and dry-brush edges, soft shapes with no ink outlines, a limited warm palette with a few saturated accents, gentle daylight, the paper's grain showing through, clear readable faces and hands.
